page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg7.24xlarge is an instance type within the ecs.hfg7 server family running on the KVM hypervisor. The instance features x86_64 architecture powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8369HB processor operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz across 96 virtual central processing units. System memory totals 384.0 GB, providing a standard allocation ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU core.

Hardware configuration for the ecs.hfg7.24xlarge excludes integrated graphics processing units and local disk storage, requiring network-attached storage solutions for persistent data workloads. Networking capabilities feature a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps without default complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Resource allocation provides high vCPU density and consistent compute execution via dedicated vCPU assignments. The absence of local disk drives requires architectural reliance on remote block storage, trading off zero-latency local storage for centralized disk management. This hardware profile aligns with large-scale general purpose workloads, enterprise application backend layers, and multi-threaded processing operations that demand dedicated compute resources.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg7.24xlarge is an ecs.hfg7 family server instance based on x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor. Powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8369HB processor running at 3.3 GHz, it delivers 96 vCPUs alongside 384.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a 4.0 GB per core ratio. The server features a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps, while omitting local storage and GPU accelerators. Persistent storage requirements rely entirely on attached network volumes. With dedicated CPU allocation and high core count, the server provides sustained compute execution for enterprise applications, multi-threaded batch operations, and general-purpose workloads requiring significant processing density without dedicated local disk drives.
